name: Tartaros University
card_quote: I'm not too talkative in Discord chats, but I still want to challenge myself and learn the game on a competitive team.
card_desc: This team is an equivalent to the Tartaros Academy team, but for people who can't be too active in chats. This is our second-level team along with Tartaros University and Banana Battalion. With a Top 25, this is the team for you if you want a more forgiving but still competitive and active environment, or if you want to prove yourself worthy of the Main Team.

requirements: Active Participation - Use most/all of your tickets daily, unless instructed otherwise.

Discord Activity - Read team and strategy announcements whenever they're posted.
Dedication to CT - Be committed to helping out your team.
